svg.title: Figure 05 · A contrarian signal in a changing market
svg.desc: Rolling mean and sample standard deviation of 63 price observations, including the formation-day close. The illustrative long/cash rule is long while z < −1. Price levels need not be stationary, and this standardization does not establish predictability.
